description: Establish the MkDocs + Material build environment and baseline config so the repo can be built into a static site. This is the environment-setup feature. It installs the generator, pins dependencies, and creates a minimal working mkdocs.yml that builds the existing content without modifying any prose. Independent of FEAT-002/003 but must come first because they extend this config.
steps: Create requirements.txt at repo root pinning the site generator: 'mkdocs>=1.6,<2' and 'mkdocs-material>=9.5,<10'. These render Korean well and resolve relative .md links natively.

Create mkdocs.yml at repo root with: site_name '오멜라스 성서 (Omelasian Bible)', theme name 'material' with `language: ko` and features [navigation.sections, navigation.top, content.code.copy] plus a light/dark palette toggle. Set `docs_dir: .` so existing files are used in place (do NOT move or copy any .md files). Set `site_dir: site`. Add `use_directory_urls: true`.

Because docs_dir is the repo root, add an `exclude_docs` block (MkDocs 1.6+ supports it) to keep the build clean: exclude '.agents/', '.git/', 'site/', 'requirements.txt', 'mkdocs.yml', 'DEPLOY.md' will be added later. Also add markdown_extensions: [toc: {permalink: true}, admonition, tables, attr_list].

Add an explicit `nav:` in mkdocs.yml with a top-level Home entry pointing at 'README.md' (English root readme serves as the landing page) plus placeholder structure; the full per-book nav is completed in FEAT-002. For now nav can list Home (README.md) and the 9 book index pages (books/NN-*/00-index.md) so the build succeeds.
Add `/site` to a root .gitignore (create it if absent) so the generated build is never committed.

Run `python3 -m mkdocs build --strict` and confirm exit 0 and that ./site is created. If --strict fails due to files present under docs_dir but absent from nav, add those paths to exclude_docs (for canon/, ideation.md, page-1.md) OR list them in nav; prefer excluding the English originals and canon from the primary nav while leaving the files untouched on disk. Do NOT edit any book/chapter/canon/English prose file.
acceptance_criteria: requirements.txt exists at repo root pinning mkdocs and mkdocs-material.
mkdocs.yml exists at repo root with theme material, language ko, docs_dir '.', site_dir 'site'.
`python3 -m mkdocs build --strict` exits 0 and creates ./site with an index.html.
No file under books/, canon/, and no README.md/ideation.md/page-1.md is modified (verify with `git status` showing only new files added).
verification: git status --porcelain books canon README.md ideation.md page-1.md  (must be empty = no prose modified)
findings:
DEVIATION from the briefing's `docs_dir: .` instruction, forced by MkDocs 1.6.1 hard validation: (1) DocsDir.post_validation rejects docs_dir being the parent directory of mkdocs.yml, so `docs_dir: .` at repo root aborts with a config error; (2) SiteDir.post_validation rejects site_dir being inside docs_dir, so `docs_dir: .` + `site_dir: site` is doubly impossible. exclude_docs does NOT bypass either check (they run before doc collection). Verified by reading mkdocs.config.config_options source. 

SOLUTION that keeps ALL hard constraints: set `docs_dir: docs` and generate docs/ as a directory of SYMLINKS pointing back at the real content (index.md -> ../README.md, books -> ../books) via scripts/build_docs_tree.py. Symlinks are new files, so every prose file under books/ stays byte-identical and `git status --porcelain books canon README.md ideation.md page-1.md` is empty. MkDocs follows the symlinks and natively rewrites relative .md links (verified: [..](chapter-01.md) -> ../chapter-01/). Both docs/ and site/ are gitignored (generated artifacts). FEAT-002/003 must run `python3 scripts/build_docs_tree.py` before `mkdocs build` (the GH Actions workflow in FEAT-003 needs this step too).

RESULTS: `python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt` -> mkdocs 1.6.1, mkdocs-material 9.7.7. `python3 -m mkdocs build --strict` -> exit 0, built in ~0.47s to ./site. site/index.html contains `<html lang="ko">`. 9 book index pages + 54 chapter pages all built and reachable; cross-links resolve. The 54 chapters show as an INFO 'not included in nav' notice (not a warning, --strict still passes) because FEAT-001 only requires a minimal nav (Home + 9 book indexes); full per-book chapter nav is FEAT-002. Committed files: requirements.txt, mkdocs.yml, .gitignore (/site, /docs), scripts/build_docs_tree.py. No prose modified.
